summary: Round-2 full-task close audit finds two major reproducibility defects and two minor verification/key-integrity defects. The actual held-out-history error and missing-P5 history-only omission are repaired; all independently checked production labels, memberships, seasonal values, repaired features and metrics match. The clean replay passes 105/105, but a damaged scratch copy also passes after 134 supported jobs are marked unsupported, 489 final-calibration keys are deleted and published diagnostics are corrupted. The required replay and empty-slot validation repairs therefore remain incomplete. The disclosed augmented/2023/H6 and pooled H6 incomplete results follow the approved G9 policy.

limitations: Standalone full-task close-audit; no audit_profile=controller-close was supplied or inferred. The result does not close/archive the task or establish controller acceptance.

Caller-supplied executor claims and committed prior reports were treated as unverified leads; no planner/executor transcript was used. Read-only scouts were used under the user standing delegation instructions; the primary reran decisive probes and performed final validation. Two scouts were interrupted at the time limit, and their partial observations were independently checked.

Production model fitting was not repeated. The ignored production manifest pins a78725763e696766bcbd47e30a508e39bef91c28 and only an unrelated untracked script; training/configuration/source/test code is unchanged between that commit and the audited SHA. The intervening code change is replay vectorization, assessed at the audited SHA. All 40 manifest-listed artifacts match their hashes; the run manifest matches the committed evidence copy.

The four-unit-suite reference-history parity test is skipped because the adjacent reference checkout is absent in the isolated clone. Synthetic smoke reduces tree counts and substitutes synthetic scope recovery/parity; it is complemented by real-source identities, independent seasonal/history checks and complete saved-model replay.

Upstream climate construction/release-time QA and retrospective oracle-weather/ideal-label-availability limitations remain inherited exclusions. The deep monthly feature builder was not rerun; its frozen source identity, committed parity evidence and current feature-consumption code were inspected.
GitNexus returned older Somalia execution flows; decisive review evidence uses pinned source rather than treating the graph as a current audit. No source index was rebuilt.

The damaged replay is an explicit scratch-only negative test. Source truth/QC mutation coverage was tested at the unchanged replay source-comparison stage; no claim is made that arbitrary truth mutations would pass every downstream check. Current production outputs had no observed extra keys or new result corruption.

Final read-only state verification is retained at /tmp/som-v4/close2/read_only_state.json (sha256 1de7366af67594f4f1e5514e45442e860eec9fd32c84b22811e300febff39ca3); original and clone HEAD are the audited SHA, original worktree has only the pre-existing unrelated untracked script, and the clone is clean.
